summary: EdgeLens Dashboard: VectorStudio enterprise seats + BYOK KMS & SCIM onboarding
description:
Issue summary: ML Platform requests procurement and onboarding for VectorStudio enterprise licenses to support the new EdgeLens (Edge AI Dashboard) pilot. Impact: ML Platform team cannot run the pilot or invite external partners until seats, SCIM provisioning, and BYOK KMS key binding are available. Urgency: pilot kick-off scheduled for 2026-03-25; procurement timeline needs acceleration.

Request details:
- 30 pilot seats for 3 months (trial) with option to scale to 200 annual seats after pilot.
- BYOK integration: customer-managed KMS key (AWS KMS) required for encryption-at-rest per product security requirements.
- SCIM provisioning via Okta with group mapping for org unit ‘ml-platform/edge-team’.
- Invoice/PO routing to cost center CC-ML-42 and tagging for forecasting.
- Vendor security artifacts required: SOC2 Type II, pen-test summary, data processing addendum (DPA).

Attachments/References: quote received from VectorStudio (attached in procurement email thread), initial security questionnaire (partial), Okta SCIM connector docs.

Desired outcome: vendor created in procurement system, PO approved, SCIM provisioning tested in staging, BYOK KMS key binding validated, pilot seats activated by 2026-03-20.
steps_to_provision: 1) Finance: confirm PO path and whether monthly invoicing or annual prepay is preferred for the pilot (CC-ML-42).
2) Procurement: validate VectorStudio contract terms and request SOC2 + DPA; negotiate trial-to-enterprise conversion clause.
3) Security: review SOC2 and DPA; confirm BYOK key acceptance and required KMS key policies/ARN format.
4) Identity: prepare Okta SCIM mapping for group 'ml-platform/edge-team' and coordinate test accounts in staging.
5) SRE/Platform: test BYOK key binding in staging with sample payloads and collect logs for auditability.
6) Ops: activate 30 pilot seats and verify seat provisioning flows and license assignment notifications.
7) Billing: confirm invoice tagging rules and attach cost center in vendor record before PO issuance.
investigation_notes: Procurement received initial quote on 2026-03-09; quote references annual SKU with 200 seats, vendor willing to provide 30-seat pilot at no charge for 90 days if BYOK and SCIM integration validated.
Security started questionnaire 2026-03-10; missing items: pen-test summary and encryption key rotation policy from vendor.
Identity tested basic SCIM connector in sandbox; mapping for nested org units in Okta requires minor transformation script (Okta helpdesk ticket opened).
Finance requires vendor W-9 and remit instructions; procurement requested vendor banking details and PO template 2026-03-11.
comments: Maya Patel (Reporter) [2026-03-10]: Requested pilot seats for EdgeLens partners. Attached initial quote and pilot requirements. Priority: need done before partner demo week.
Procurement Team (2026-03-11): Confirmed receipt of quote. Opening vendor onboarding in Coupa and pinging vendor for SOC2 and bank details. Assigned procurement case 2026-03-11.
Security (2026-03-11): SOC2 docs received but missing pen-test summary and BYOK acceptance checklist. Requested vendor to supply cryptographic key management documentation and key rotation policy.

Identity (2026-03-12): Ran SCIM provisioning smoke test against vendor sandbox. User group attributes map but we need 'orgUnitPath' transformation; creating small mapping lambda to normalize. ETA 2026-03-17.

Liam O'Connor (Assignee) (2026-03-12): Planning coordination call with procurement + security + identity on 2026-03-13 to align deliverables. Adding steps to validate BYOK via test key ARN and rotate procedure.
next_action: 1) Procurement to secure vendor bank details and PO template by 2026-03-13. 2) Security to confirm BYOK acceptance checklist with vendor by 2026-03-14. 3) Identity to deploy SCIM mapping lambda to staging and retest 2026-03-17.
